clips.title: The story
paras: At Starbreeze Village, Gaerolas Talvethren guards the Sleeping druids in troubled Teldrassil. He seeks aid against aggressive furbolgs and corruption spreading through the boughs.

Gaerolas Talvethren guards the Sleeping druids at Starbreeze Village. They slumber in communion with the Emerald Dream, and his watch has grown uneasy as unnatural corruption spreads through the forest and unsettles Teldrassil.

Gaerolas calls on travelers to push back the Gnarlpine furbolgs, whose minds have turned to madness and savagery. He hopes to uncover the taint spreading from their shamans and the roots of their distress, preserving what sanctity remains in eastern Teldrassil.
